reasoning_content: The app uses Postgres via GORM. Let's check whether the DB is required when the server starts. I'll look for where the DB is initialized — is it at server startup time, or only when it's used?

action.command: sed -n 1,100p pkg/db/db.go; echo "---USERS---"; grep -rn "db.GetDB\|db.InitDB\|db.GetDBConnection\|NewDB" pkg/ cmd/ --include="*.go" | grep -v _test | head
